name: Journey Design 2.0
description: Single source for Journey's design tokens. The Journey Hub (design/hub) is generated from it, and the app's theme file will be too. Change values here, then rebuild the hub.

font.stack: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

accent.note: Sun chosen on 8 Nov 2026. Iris and Lagoon stay in the hub for comparison until all screens are reviewed.

iris.label: Iris
iris.note: Violet-blue. Calm and modern, and glows in dark mode.

lagoon.label: Lagoon
lagoon.note: Mint-teal. Fresh and outdoorsy, made for trips.

sun.label: Sun
sun.note: Golden yellow. Energetic and optimistic, made for challenges.

fixed.note: The same in light and dark. Stage is the near-black behind full-photo screens; scrim dims the page under a sheet; black is behind photos opened edge to edge; white is the knob of a switch.
The same in light and dark: under a sheet, under a switch's knob, around a picture that overlaps a photo, and under a card on the stage.

layout.note: Where a screen's content starts from the edge, and the room above a section. Gaps inside a component are plain numbers on a 2-point grid.

typeNote: Every text size in the app is one of these. In the app each is a Txt variant, named in camelCase ("Body small" is bodySmall). Tracking is in em.

type.name: Hero
type.use: The one line on the welcome screen

type.name: Display large
type.use: The big number on a full-photo screen

type.name: Display
type.use: A big number or initials

type.name: Heading
type.use: The title at the top of a screen

type.name: Title large
type.use: A journey's or a person's name on their own page

type.name: Title
type.use: An entry's title when it is open

type.name: Title small
type.use: Titles of sheets, sections and empty states

type.name: Subtitle
type.use: The headline of a card or a group

type.name: Subheading
type.use: Bar titles and titles in a list of entries

type.name: Headline
type.use: The title of a row or a small card

type.name: Body large
type.use: Text being read or typed on its own
type.sample: Left the guesthouse at 3am and rode up in the dark.

type.name: Lead
type.use: The sentence under a screen's title
type.sample: This is how people see you when you share a journey.

type.name: Body
type.use: Ordinary text
type.sample: Left the guesthouse at 3am and rode up in the dark.

type.name: Item
type.use: Labels of rows, links and names

type.name: Body small
type.use: Longer text in a tight place
type.sample: Nothing here yet. Follow a journey to see it grow.

type.name: Control
type.use: Chips, small buttons and card titles

type.name: Callout
type.use: A sentence that explains a choice
type.sample: Only people with the link can see it.

type.name: Note
type.use: The start of an entry under its title
type.sample: Rode the Hai Van pass before the rain.

type.name: Caption
type.use: A line of detail under a title

type.name: Footnote
type.use: Detail under a row's label

type.name: Small
type.use: Pills, tab labels and timestamps

type.name: Tiny
type.use: Numbers in a grid and fine print

type.name: Label
type.use: The small capital line above a title

type.name: Micro
type.use: Tab bar labels and tiny badges
